title: LADM LA_BoundaryFaceString (JSON-FG)
description: A directed linear boundary element (curve) that separates two adjacent spatial units. The direction of the LineString defines left/right adjacency: the spatial unit to the left of the directed curve is 'leftUnit'; to the right is 'rightUnit'. A closed spatial unit boundary is formed by an ordered set of LA_BoundaryFaceString instances referenced from LA_SpatialUnit.properties.boundaryFaceStrings. Shared edges between adjacent parcels are stored only once.

featureType.description: Discriminator identifying this as a directed cadastral boundary segment

coordRefSys.description: CRS for the 'place' geometry. Inherits from FeatureCollection if omitted.

place.description: The directed linear geometry of this boundary segment. Must be a LineString or MultiLineString. Direction determines left/right unit assignment.

type.description: Boundary type (e.g. cadastralBoundary, administrativeBoundary, road, waterCourse). References a CodeList such as LA_BoundaryFaceStringType.

isDirected.description: If true (default), the direction of the LineString is significant: left/right unit assignments are relative to the curve direction. If false, the curve is undirected and leftUnit/rightUnit are interchangeable.

leftUnit.description: The spatial unit to the left of this directed boundary. Absent if the boundary is on the outer edge of the cadastral coverage (no left neighbour).

rightUnit.description: The spatial unit to the right of this directed boundary. Absent if the boundary is on the outer edge of the cadastral coverage (no right neighbour).

spatialSource.description: References to the spatial source(s) (surveys) that determined this boundary

lifespanVersion.description: System/database lifespan of this boundary face string version

allOf.$comment: --- RULE: at least one of leftUnit or rightUnit must be declared ---
